## 04_Score_And_Rank_Slots
`Total = 0.25·S_period + 0.25·S_weather + 0.20·S_buffer + 0.20·S_rest + 0.10·S_habit`
Input: `{ slots[], busy_events[], preferred_period, avoid_rain, is_outdoor, habit_hours[], warnings[] }`
Biên: period rỗng/any→100 · avoid_rain=false→S_weather=100 · is_outdoor=null & avoid_rain=true→ngoài trời · rain_probability=MAX các giờ.
Output: top 3 (S1 điểm cao nhất) + `score_breakdown`.
